# Convert MOV to MP4

- Route: `/tools/convert-mov-to-mp4`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `video`
- Slug: `convert-mov-to-mp4`

## Summary

Turn QuickTime and iPhone .mov files into a universal MP4 that plays and uploads everywhere. (Video tools)

## Details

MOV is Apple’s QuickTime container — it is what iPhones, Macs, and many cameras record by default. It is great inside the Apple ecosystem, but it can refuse to play on Windows, Android, or some upload forms. Converting MOV to MP4 keeps the same H.264 video and AAC audio in a container the whole world accepts, usually with no visible quality change.
### What it does
- Converts QuickTime / iPhone .mov files to MP4.
- Locks the output to MP4 (H.264 + AAC) so the result plays everywhere.
- Adds -pix_fmt yuv420p and +faststart so the MP4 plays in browsers and starts instantly.
- Trim the MOV, resize it or pick a quality preset in the same upload.
### How to use it
1. Upload your MOV: Drop in a .mov file from your iPhone, Mac, or camera.
2. Output is locked to MP4: No format picking needed — MP4 is set for this tool.
3. Convert: We re-wrap/re-encode the video into a clean MP4.
4. Download: Save your MP4, ready for any device or platform.
### Supported formats
- Input: mov, qt
- Output: mp4
- Output is locked to MP4 (H.264 + AAC, yuv420p, +faststart).
### Technical details
- Most MOV files already contain H.264 video, so the conversion is fast and near-lossless at High quality.
- We force yuv420p chroma so the MP4 plays in Safari and on social platforms that reject 4:2:2/4:4:4 video.
- If your MOV holds ProRes, the converter transcodes it down to H.264 — pick High quality to keep the most detail.
### Use cases
- iPhone videos: Convert a .mov recorded on an iPhone so it plays on a Windows PC.
- Upload to the web: Turn a QuickTime export into an MP4 a website will accept.
- Send to non-Apple users: Share footage with Android and Windows users without playback issues.
- Editor compatibility: Feed an MP4 into editors that struggle with raw MOV.
### FAQ
Q: How do I convert MOV to MP4?
A: Upload your .mov file and click convert — the output is already set to MP4, so there is nothing else to choose.
Q: Does converting MOV to MP4 lose quality?
A: Most MOV files use H.264, so at High quality the re-encode is visually near-lossless. Lower presets trade some quality for a smaller file.
Q: Why will my iPhone MOV not play on Windows?
A: Windows may lack the QuickTime/HEVC codecs. MP4 with H.264 + AAC plays without extra software.
Q: Is QuickTime to MP4 the same thing?
A: Yes — QuickTime files use the .mov container, so converting QuickTime to MP4 is exactly this tool.
Q: Is there a watermark or signup?
A: No watermark and no account required. Files are kept 24 hours for guests; with a free account you choose 24 hours to 2 years.
